agent.explanation: No candidate is eligible (catalog status: no_solution). Reported motor failure is not a verified diagnosis; wiring, driver, and power must be inspected first. tt-motor-148 (TT gear motor 1:48, $1.60 catalog unit) is the only option matching the original geometry, but it is rejected because its 3–6 V range is below the 7.4 V rail. n20-gearmotor-100 ($3.20) is also rejected on the same voltage limit and changes appearance. jga25-370-12v ($7.50) is partial: its 6–12 V range covers the 7.4 V rail, but its 62×25×25 mm body and up to ~2 A stall current are unverified against the original mounting and the driver's peak rating, and it is not a same-appearance replacement. Every candidate is within the $30 budget on known unit cost, but shipping, tax, and labor are unknown, so the total is unconfirmed. The full rover also has unresolved board-level failures (clearance/all_rules, disconnected copper islands), and the thermal model is limited to 7.4 V despite the 12 V label. All design previews are unverified and none of this is physical repair or purchase approval.
missing_info: Confirmed diagnosis that the motor is the failed part (wiring, driver output, and supply checked first)
Actual rail voltage and the driver's voltage and peak-current ratings
Original motor's dimensions, shaft type, and mounting for appearance and fit comparison
Whether a voltage-compatible option at or near the TT motor's geometry exists, or whether a driver/power change is acceptable
Resolution of board clearance/all_rules failures and disconnected copper islands
Live pricing with shipping and tax to confirm the $30 exclusive budget
Physical fit and stall-current verification for any candidate
